title: The fallen book
starting_code:
# This line is already written: it finds the book and keeps it in the variable `treasure`.
treasure = wizard.find_nearest("book")

# Make it glow with `reveal`. It is a method of the book, so you must use it
# by putting a dot right after the variable in which we kept the book.

# Walk left to the book.

# Pick it up with `pick_up`.
hints: `reveal` is the book's method, so the variable, the object you want to reveal, goes before the dot, as with `door`.
The book lies four steps to the left.
`pick_up` is your wizard's method and needs nothing between its brackets.
intro: A book on the floor again... The first line, which I have already written, finds it and keeps it in `treasure`. Make it glow, walk to it and pick it up. Read the comments in the program: they tell you what to do on each line. And if you get stuck, ask for a hint.
outro: Let me take it; I will put it back on its shelf.
learned: Now you know that a method can give something back, that a variable keeps it, and that the thing kept has its own methods.
